message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "A well-circumscribed mass with homogeneous opacity, consistent with pleuropulmonary synovial sarcoma (PPSS).", "reason": "The chest X-ray (Figure 1) demonstrates a large, dense, well-circumscribed opacity in the right upper hemithorax with smooth margins and homogeneous density. This appearance is distinct from the irregular or spiculated margins typical of primary lung carcinoma (Options A, F) and lacks the fluid levels of an abscess (Option D). The well-defined, rounded morphology is characteristic of pleuropulmonary synovial sarcoma."}
